title: Multi-Table Reports reference solution
answer: SELECT c.customer_id, c.full_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) AS purchase_total FROM customers AS c LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.full_name ORDER BY c.customer_id;
explanation: Each customer appears once, including customers with no orders. Review the query against the lab data and explain why the chosen joins, filters, aggregation grain, ordering, or transaction boundary is correct.
